commands.calc.help.config.complex:
Complex mode: disabled by default. Enable for I and complex solutions.
    /calc config complex enable|disable|default
commands.calc.help.config.power_order:
Display order: ascending (default) or descending.
    /calc config power-order <order>
commands.calc.help.detail.config.descrip: Configure calculation mode and result presentation without rewriting the saved ans.
commands.calc.help.detail.config.params:
<setting> — complex, power-order or default.
    complex — enable / disable / default; initially disabled.
    power-order — ascending / descending / default.
commands.calc.help.detail.diff.descripti: Differentiate a function in the supplied variable order.
commands.calc.help.detail.diff.params:
<function> — Function to differentiate.
    <variables> — x,y: mixed derivative; x,x: second derivative.
    [--at <variable=value,...>]
      Substitute values after differentiation.
commands.calc.help.detail.expand.descrip: Expand products or powers in a symbolic expression.
commands.calc.help.detail.expression.des: Evaluate a calculator expression and save the last successful result to ans.
commands.calc.help.detail.integrate.desc: Find an antiderivative, or use --internal for a definite integral.
commands.calc.help.detail.integrate.para:
<integrand> — Function to integrate.
    <variable> — One variable, such as x.
    [--internal <lower-limit> <upper-limit>]
      Supply both real bounds, or omit for an antiderivative.
      Chat shows + C; ans excludes the constant.
commands.calc.help.detail.limit.descript: Compute a limit at a finite point or at infinity.
commands.calc.help.detail.limit.params:
<function> — Function whose limit you want.
    <variable> — One variable, such as x.
    <point> — Real expression, inf or -inf.
    [both|left|right] — Approach direction; default: both.
commands.calc.help.detail.numfmt.descrip: Configure inventory-style box, stack, and remainder formatting.
commands.calc.help.detail.numfmt.params:
<subcommand>
      enable, disable, scope, format, template, default.
    <value> — Omit to show the current value.
commands.calc.help.detail.simplify.descr: Simplify a symbolic expression; cancellation may remove singularities of the original expression.
commands.calc.help.detail.solve.descript: Solve an equation or system. complex is disabled by default; enabling it allows complex solutions.
commands.calc.help.detail.solve.params:
<equations> — Separate equations with ;.
    <variables> — Separate unknowns with commas: x,y.
commands.calc.help.footer: Click a command for details. Tab completes input.
commands.calc.help.functions:
Constants: pi, e, I, ans. Names are case-insensitive.
    Use * for multiplication. ans keeps the last successful result.
    n(expression,digits): decimal approximation, 1–1000 significant digits.
commands.calc.help.insert_example: Click to put this example in chat.
commands.calc.help.notes.diff:
x,y differentiates successively; x,x gives the second derivative.
    --at substitutes values simultaneously after differentiating.
    Other symbols are parameters; complex values require complex mode.
commands.calc.help.notes.integrate:
Omit --internal for an antiderivative + C; ans excludes C.
    Both bounds must be finite real numbers.
    Wrap bounds containing spaces in parentheses; reversed bounds work.
commands.calc.help.notes.limit:
Direction: both (default), left or right.
    Approach a finite real point, inf or -inf.
    A two-sided limit fails if its one-sided limits disagree.
    The result may be positive or negative infinity.
commands.calc.help.notes.solve:
Use = or ==; separate equations with ;.
    List unknowns with commas and no spaces: x,y.
    Real solutions by default; enable complex for complex solutions.
commands.calc.help.numeric_functions:
Angles use radians; rad/deg convert angles.
    log(base,x): any base; ln/lg/log2: base e/10/2.
    round(x,digits): -1000 to 1000 places; ties round toward +infinity.
    ceildiv, gcd and lcm require integer arguments.
commands.calc.help.numfmt.format:
Types: integer (default), double (non-integers), all.
    /calc numfmt format <type>
commands.calc.help.numfmt.scope:
Scope: expression, integrate, diff, limit, solve.
    /calc numfmt scope add|remove <command>
commands.calc.help.numfmt.template:
Presets: shulker-stack-item, stack-item, item; Tab shows templates.
    Custom: 1–3 {} for items / stacks + items / boxes + stacks + items.
    Maximum: 256 characters. --stack <size> sets items per stack.
commands.calc.numfmt.error.invalid_templ: Use 1-3 paired empty placeholders {} in the template; maximum length: 256 characters
commands.calc.numfmt.error.save_failed: Could not save the number-format configuration; check write access to the config directory
